head: One UI 9.5 may move the Now Bar around the camera, like the Dynamic Island
dek: Samsung's live notifications pill, the Now Bar, may move from beside the clock to the middle of the screen, wrapped around the front camera, according to a One UI 9.5 build SamMobile obtained. Samsung hasn't announced it, and it isn't in the current One UI 9.5 beta.
details: Tapping the pill would still open more details and controls, and you'd swipe left and right on it to switch between activities instead of up and down. A new Moment Effects option would add animations, for now around sports events such as a team scoring. The report expects it on the Galaxy S27 phones early in 2027 and on older Galaxy phones with the stable One UI 9.5 update.
where: Leak; expected with the Galaxy S27 in early 2027, later for older Galaxy phones
means: If you use the Now Bar for timers, music or deliveries, it may sit in a new place at the top of the screen after the update.
todo: Nothing to do yet; the change isn't in any update you can install.
thumb_words: GALAXY NOW BAR AROUND THE CAMERA?
